sloka: सो ऽम्बुजो हरिणा ध्मातः सर्वप्राणेन शङ्खराट् ।ररास भीमनिर्हादस्त्रैलोक्यं व्यथयन्निव ।। ७.७.१० ॥
transliteration: so 'mbujo hariṇā dhmātaḥ sarvaprāṇena śaṅkharāṭ ।rarāsa bhīmanirhādastrailokyaṁ vyathayanniva ।। 7.7.10 ॥

translations.english: That water-born king of conches, blown by Hari with all his might, roared with a terrible sound, as if terrifying the three worlds.
